energy.meaning: Absolute incoming beam energy, including rest energy.
energy.conditions: Use a positive physical beam energy; it is not kinetic energy.

particles.meaning: Physical bunch population; sets the charge represented by the macroparticles.
particles.conditions: The card value is in units of 10^10; n_m independently sets numerical sampling.

sigma_x.meaning: Incoming transverse RMS size at the waist.
sigma_x.conditions: The negative default requests derivation from normalized emittance and beta. Supply two consistent quantities among size, emittance and beta.

sigma_y.meaning: Incoming transverse RMS size at the waist.
sigma_y.conditions: The negative default requests derivation from normalized emittance and beta. Supply two consistent quantities among size, emittance and beta.

sigma_z.meaning: Incoming longitudinal RMS bunch length, including for the uniform longitudinal distribution.
sigma_z.conditions: Generated bunches use dist_z; finite cut_z truncates the admitted sample.

emitt_x.meaning: Normalized transverse emittance used to derive beam size and angular divergence.
emitt_x.conditions: The negative default is an unset sentinel; supply a consistent size/emittance/beta pair.

emitt_y.meaning: Normalized transverse emittance used to derive beam size and angular divergence.
emitt_y.conditions: The negative default is an unset sentinel; supply a consistent size/emittance/beta pair.

beta_x.meaning: Transverse beta function at the incoming waist.
beta_x.conditions: The negative default is an unset sentinel; it does not represent negative physical beta.

beta_y.meaning: Transverse beta function at the incoming waist.
beta_y.conditions: The negative default is an unset sentinel; it does not represent negative physical beta.

angle_x.meaning: Crossing geometry implemented as a slice-position shear in the selected plane.
angle_x.conditions: Stored native momenta do not include this crossing angle; laboratory angular observables require the documented design-axis transformation.

angle_y.meaning: Crossing geometry implemented as a slice-position shear in the selected plane.
angle_y.conditions: Stored native momenta do not include this crossing angle; laboratory angular observables require the documented design-axis transformation.

angle_phi.meaning: Roll of the transverse incoming coordinates about the longitudinal axis.
angle_phi.conditions: Applied before incoming offsets/maps unless the loaded beam is declared pretransformed.

offset_x.meaning: Incoming bunch displacement in the named coordinate.
offset_x.conditions: An unsuffixed mirrored assignment gives opposite beam offsets; explicit .1/.2 assignments use the supplied signs.

offset_y.meaning: Incoming bunch displacement in the named coordinate.
offset_y.conditions: An unsuffixed mirrored assignment gives opposite beam offsets; explicit .1/.2 assignments use the supplied signs.

offset_z.meaning: Incoming bunch displacement in the named coordinate.
offset_z.conditions: An unsuffixed mirrored assignment gives opposite beam offsets; explicit .1/.2 assignments use the supplied signs.

waist_x.meaning: Longitudinal displacement of the transverse waist used in initial backtracking.
waist_x.conditions: These are longitudinal distances, not transverse beam offsets or crab-waist fractions.

waist_y.meaning: Longitudinal displacement of the transverse waist used in initial backtracking.
waist_y.conditions: These are longitudinal distances, not transverse beam offsets or crab-waist fractions.

dist_x.conditions: Only 0 (Gaussian) is implemented; nonzero values are rejected.

dist_z.conditions: 0 Gaussian; 1 uniform over ±sqrt(3)*sigma_z. Other values stop generation.

trav_focus.meaning: Use the longitudinal particle position in initial waist backtracking (traveling-focus prescription).
trav_focus.conditions: 0 ordinary bunch initialization; nonzero enables the inherited traveling-focus branch. It is not a transported focusing-system model.

polar_x.meaning: Initial rest-frame polarization-vector component on fixed native axes.
polar_x.conditions: A physical polarization vector has norm≤1. Local helicity is its projection onto the actual momentum; beam 2's reference direction is −z.

polar_y.meaning: Initial rest-frame polarization-vector component on fixed native axes.
polar_y.conditions: A physical polarization vector has norm≤1. Local helicity is its projection onto the actual momentum; beam 2's reference direction is −z.

polar_z.meaning: Initial rest-frame polarization-vector component on fixed native axes.
polar_z.conditions: A physical polarization vector has norm≤1. Local helicity is its projection onto the actual momentum; beam 2's reference direction is −z.

charge_sign.meaning: Relative interaction-charge sign: negative for opposite-charge beams, positive for like-charge beams.
charge_sign.conditions: Magnitude also enters native charge scaling; use −1 for the standard electron–positron cards. Do not infer species from a nonstandard value.

f_rep.meaning: Train repetition frequency; per-IP crossing frequency is f_rep*n_b.
f_rep.conditions: Used to convert single-crossing luminosity to a rate, not to change a collision trajectory.

n_b.meaning: Number of bunch crossings per train at one interaction point.
n_b.conditions: Together with f_rep determines rate normalization; the native simulation still describes one crossing.

scale_step.meaning: Per-beam multiplier of position drift, leaving the momentum-kick interval unchanged.
scale_step.conditions: Use 1 for physical drift/kick consistency. Nonunit values are refused with spin and warned about otherwise.

espread.meaning: Relative energy-spread scale applied to generated/loaded primaries before incoming maps when do_espread is enabled.
espread.conditions: Its interpretation depends on which_espread; the uniform law has RMS 0.9815*espread.

which_espread.meaning: Initial energy distribution applied by do_espread.
which_espread.conditions: 0 unchanged; 1 uniform relative offset in[−1.7,+1.7]*espread; 2 equal mixture at±espread; 3 Gaussian RMS espread. Other integers fall through to unchanged energy; use only 0–3.

couple_xy.meaning: Registered inherited parameter with no implemented physics effect.
couple_xy.conditions: A nonzero value produces a warning. Remove it; no replacement implementing this legacy control is supplied.

xi_x.meaning: Registered inherited parameter with no implemented physics effect.
xi_x.conditions: A nonzero value produces a warning. Remove it; no replacement implementing this legacy control is supplied.

xi_y.meaning: Registered inherited parameter with no implemented physics effect.
xi_y.conditions: A nonzero value produces a warning. Remove it; no replacement implementing this legacy control is supplied.

n_x.meaning: Number of cells across the main transverse mesh in the named direction.
n_x.conditions: Must support the selected solver. The internal FFT fallback requires powers of two; FFTW and adaptive routes impose their own preflight constraints.

n_y.meaning: Number of cells across the main transverse mesh in the named direction.
n_y.conditions: Must support the selected solver. The internal FFT fallback requires powers of two; FFTW and adaptive routes impose their own preflight constraints.

n_z.meaning: Number of longitudinal slices per bunch.
n_z.conditions: Positive resolved slice count; incoming maps additionally bound their transverse displacement per slice. Independent slice refinement is required.

n_t.conditions: Positive count. Increasing it refines primary and secondary field evolution but does not increase initial macroparticle statistics.

n_m.conditions: Positive count for generated beams; loaded records determine the loaded population. It is not the physical bunch charge.

cut_x.conditions: A negative default delegates to the sizing path. Check actual printed extent and lost/deposited charge; extra grids do not recover missing central deposition.

cut_y.conditions: A negative default delegates to the sizing path. Check actual printed extent and lost/deposited charge; extra grids do not recover missing central deposition.

cut_z.conditions: The negative default delegates to the setup path; admitted Gaussian charge depends on this cut.

cut_x_factor.meaning: Width multiplier used by the corresponding beam-based cut selection.
cut_x_factor.conditions: Negative is an unset sentinel. Meaning depends on generated versus loaded/sized setup; inspect evaluated cuts rather than assuming a universal default multiple.

cut_y_factor.meaning: Width multiplier used by the corresponding beam-based cut selection.
cut_y_factor.conditions: Negative is an unset sentinel. Meaning depends on generated versus loaded/sized setup; inspect evaluated cuts rather than assuming a universal default multiple.

cut_z_factor.meaning: Width multiplier used by the corresponding beam-based cut selection.
cut_z_factor.conditions: Negative is an unset sentinel. Meaning depends on generated versus loaded/sized setup; inspect evaluated cuts rather than assuming a universal default multiple.

grids.meaning: Total nested transverse field grids, including the main mesh.
grids.conditions: Values≤1 select no extra grid; larger values add outer field-gather meshes. Many parallel/adaptive modes require exactly 1.

integration_method.conditions: 2 is the FFT convolution used by supplied benchmarks and accelerated routes; 1/3 select inherited alternative field paths. Do not change this as a mere performance switch without validation.

electron_distribution_rho.meaning: Primary charge assignment to transverse mesh cells.
electron_distribution_rho.conditions: 1 nearest-cell assignment; 2 cloud-in-cell assignment. Accelerated/adaptive contracts require 2. The mover's interpolation is an internal setting, not a separate registered interpolation keyword.

automatic_grid_sizing.meaning: Estimate transverse mesh cuts and resolution from beam moments.
automatic_grid_sizing.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Nonzero crossing angle is refused because this sizing path double counts the spatial shear; use explicit cuts or optimize_grids.

optimize_grids.meaning: Derive grid settings from beam widths and crossing geometry.
optimize_grids.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. This is a setup heuristic, not an observable-convergence certificate.

cuts_from_loaded_beam.meaning: Derive admission/mesh cuts using loaded beam coordinates.
cuts_from_loaded_beam.conditions: Has no effect for program-generated beams and warns in that case.

charge_symmetric.meaning: Generate reflection-related macroparticles to impose initial charge symmetry.
charge_symmetric.conditions: 0 independent generation; nonzero uses the inherited symmetric generator. Reflected samples are not independent random draws.

force_symmetric.conditions: 0 ordinary solver; nonzero symmetry path. Parallel/adaptive qualified envelopes require 0.

do_eloss.meaning: Primary beamstrahlung radiation and associated energy loss.
do_eloss.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_photons.meaning: Materialize beamstrahlung macro-photons for the selected beam.
do_photons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_photon_lumi.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_coherent.meaning: Coherent electron–positron conversion from photons in the beam field.
do_coherent.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_trident.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_pairs.meaning: Incoherent electron–positron production from real/virtual photon collisions.
do_pairs.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_muons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_hadrons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_compt.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_compt_phot.meaning: Retain Compton-generated photons in the background path.
do_compt_phot.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_isr.meaning: Initial-state radiation in sampled electron collision kinematics.
do_isr.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_espread.meaning: Apply the incoming beam energy-spread distribution.
do_espread.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

bmt_precession.meaning: Primary Thomas–BMT spin precession in gathered beam fields.
bmt_precession.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

ST_spin_flip.meaning: Spin-dependent radiation transitions and conditional spin evolution.
ST_spin_flip.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_bds_spin_rotation.meaning: Rotate initial spin using the inherited beam-delivery angular prescription.
do_bds_spin_rotation.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

track_pairs.meaning: Transport electron/positron secondaries or imported events through the beam fields.
track_pairs.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

track_muons.meaning: Transport produced muons through the beam fields.
track_muons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_tertphot.meaning: Secondary-track radiation photons in the inherited tertiary-photon path.
do_tertphot.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

beam_pair.meaning: Store/track the associated scattered beam-particle contribution during pair production.
beam_pair.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_beam.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_photons.meaning: Write stored photons after the collision.
store_photons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_hadrons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_muons.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_jets.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_native.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_cross.meaning: Accumulate the inherited electron cross-section/event diagnostic.
do_cross.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_size_log.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_dump.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

do_edm4hep.meaning: Write EDM4hep output when that optional build support is available.
do_edm4hep.conditions: Use 0 off or 1 on. Legacy boolean branches may accept other nonzero integers; coupled process/backend constraints still apply.

store_pairs.conditions: 0 none; 1 final pairs.dat; values>1 also initial pairs0.dat. Column 8 is a process code, not a weight.

do_lumi.meaning: Bit mask selecting sampled luminosity event outputs.
do_lumi.conditions: Bit 1 e−e+; bit 2 both eγ/γe; bit 4 γγ. Combine by addition; 0 disables event storage, not every integrated luminosity accumulator.

load_beam.meaning: Choose generated primaries or legacy beam-file import.
load_beam.conditions: 0 generate; 3 load both beams.1/2 are explicitly unimplemented. Use loaded_beam_is_pretransformed to avoid applying maps twice.

load_photons.meaning: Load initial photons from the native photon input path.
load_photons.conditions: 0 off; nonzero loads. Supply the expected file and check beam/source sign conventions.

load_events.meaning: Read event.ini secondary tracks at their explicit native admission counters.
load_events.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Requires track_pairs for deflection; eight columns in mode 0 and eleven in imported_spin_mode1.

loaded_beam_is_pretransformed.meaning: Declare loaded coordinates already contain incoming transforms.
loaded_beam_is_pretransformed.conditions: 0 applies roll, crossing shear, offsets and maps; 1 skips them. A true pretransformed beam cannot also request incoming-map reslicing.

imported_spin_mode.meaning: Spin transport for explicitly supplied imported electron/positron tracks.
imported_spin_mode.conditions: 0 legacy unpolarized format; 1 BMT with eleven-column spin input and imported radiation off. Other modes, including radiative spin flips, are rejected; pure imported population required.

do_bhabhas.meaning: Enable the inherited Bhabha event-input/reweighting path.
do_bhabhas.conditions: Distinct from a manufactured event.ini fixture; inspect the required Bhabha input and normalization before interpreting rates.

do_jets.meaning: Select the inherited photon-collision minijet model.
do_jets.conditions: 0 off; 1 uses Lambda4=0.4 GeV and 2 uses 0.2 GeV. Other nonzero values have no defined initialization branch. This optional model is not qualified by beam-spectrum benchmarks.

jet_pythia.meaning: Select PYTHIA-backed rather than internal minijet initialization.
jet_pythia.conditions: 0 internal; nonzero PYTHIA path, requiring its external inputs/build support.

jet_log.meaning: Select the inherited minijet sampling parameterization.
jet_log.conditions: Forwarded to the jet model; retain the value of a validated jet card. It is not a general logging verbosity switch.

jet_ptmin.meaning: Minimum transverse momentum used to initialize the minijet model.
jet_ptmin.conditions: Positive physical threshold for an enabled jet model.

do_prod.meaning: Reserved inherited production path that is incomplete.
do_prod.conditions: do_prod must remain 0; a nonzero request is rejected. prod_e/prod_scal have no active replacement in supported runs.

prod_e.meaning: Reserved inherited production path that is incomplete.
prod_e.conditions: do_prod must remain 0; a nonzero request is rejected. prod_e/prod_scal have no active replacement in supported runs.

prod_scal.meaning: Reserved inherited production path that is incomplete.
prod_scal.conditions: do_prod must remain 0; a nonzero request is rejected. prod_e/prod_scal have no active replacement in supported runs.

pair_model.conditions: 0 existing FeeBL EPA with corrected BW normalization; 1 corrected transverse EPA; 2 massive tree-level BH/LL kernels. Mode 2 requires extended long-double precision. Internal exact amplitudes do not remove the approximate beam-direction mapping.

pair_exact_rr.meaning: Roulette scale for exact BH/LL kernel evaluation.
pair_exact_rr.conditions: Finite and nonnegative; 0 disables roulette. Evaluated proposals include inverse-probability compensation, with a 5% minimum evaluation probability. This changes sampling cost and variance, not the physical cross section.

photon_timing.meaning: Position, birth-step exposure and direction model for emitted photons.
photon_timing.conditions: 0 legacy; 1 synchronized position and half birth-step exposure; 2 diagnostic synchronized position with full birth-step exposure; 3 synchronized with time-centered direction. Modes 1/3 require coherent_model=1 when coherent conversion is enabled.

photon_angle.conditions: 0 collinear; 1 LCFA angle; 2 apply that angle only when the formation length is below half the opposing bunch length. Samples outside the small-angle domain (|angle|>0.1 rad or transverse beta squared>=1) stop the run; they are not clipped or resampled.

photon_polarisation.meaning: Track beamstrahlung photon Stokes parameters and polarization-dependent pair production.
photon_polarisation.conditions: 0 unpolarized; 1 enabled, requiring pair_model=1 or 2. Coherent conversion additionally requires coherent_model=1. This is distinct from primary-lepton spin tracking.

coherent_model.conditions: 0 inherited sampling; 1 corrected substepping without applying the intermediate conversion probability twice. Mode 1 is required with polarized photons or synchronized half-exposure photon timing when coherent conversion is active.

pair_q2.meaning: Virtual-photon virtuality veto in EPA pair production.
pair_q2.conditions: 0 veto above lepton mass squared; 1 above pT²+mass²; 2 above E_gamma1*E_gamma2 (s/4 in the head-on photon approximation). Enabled pair/muon production requires 0–2. This does not replace mode 2 exact kinematics.

pair_ecut.meaning: Minimum daughter total energy at admission for the named secondary species.
pair_ecut.conditions: Not a continuously applied transport cut. Generation/storage acceptance depends on the process as well as tracking; report this threshold with yields. Pair creation requires invariant mass above twice the daughter mass; each individual daughter instead requires E>=mass.

muon_ecut.meaning: Minimum daughter total energy at admission for the named secondary species.
muon_ecut.conditions: Not a continuously applied transport cut. Generation/storage acceptance depends on the process as well as tracking; report this threshold with yields. Pair creation requires invariant mass above twice the daughter mass; each individual daughter instead requires E>=mass.

pair_step.meaning: Secondary step-refinement multiplier used to limit the bend per tracking substep.
pair_step.conditions: Larger positive values generally produce smaller tracking steps. It also applies to muon transport.

pair_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
pair_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

muon_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
muon_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

photon_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
photon_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

bhabha_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
bhabha_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

hadron_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
hadron_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

jet_ratio.meaning: Sampling enhancement/thinning factor for the named stored/generated population.
jet_ratio.conditions: Not a physical cross-section multiplier to be applied again in analysis; track each process's weight convention. Row counts alone are generally not physical yields.

muon_scale.meaning: Sampling enhancement passed to the muon production weight.
muon_scale.conditions: Must be finite and positive when muon production is enabled. Its enhancement is removed from physical yield counters; record the value when interpreting stored rows.

electron_ratio.meaning: Sampling factor for electron collision pairs/records.
electron_ratio.conditions: The default 0 is not a declaration of zero physical beam charge. Optimized luminosity contracts may require exactly 1.

ecm_min.meaning: Threshold used by the electron collision/cross-section path.
ecm_min.conditions: Does not replace the W≥0.98W0 selection in peak diagnostics.

ecm_min_gg.meaning: Photon-channel threshold parameter converted internally to gg_smin=4*ecm_min_gg².
ecm_min_gg.conditions: The factor 4 is part of the implemented convention; do not treat this input as an arbitrary histogram lower edge.

emin.meaning: Inherited low-energy threshold passed to primary/secondary movement and beam import interfaces.
emin.conditions: Some loaded-particle interfaces explicitly ignore it. It is not a universal cut on every stored particle; prefer process-specific pair_ecut/muon_ecut for those populations.

bhabha_ecmload.meaning: Centre-of-mass energy used to normalize the imported Bhabha sample.
bhabha_ecmload.conditions: Must describe the actual external sample; independent of the manufactured event.ini fixture energy.

bhabha_scal.conditions: Use the normalization matching the external sample and report it with bhabha_ratio.

compt_x_min.meaning: Minimum Compton invariant scale relative to 4*m_e².
compt_x_min.conditions: The code requires s≥4*m_e²*compt_x_min; dimensionless, not an energy in GeV.

compt_emax.conditions: Applied inside the Compton background path.

compt_scale.conditions: Keep the physical weight convention in the background model; raw rows are not automatically event yields.

beam_size.meaning: Finite transverse beam-size correction in virtual-photon generation.
beam_size.conditions: 0 photon at parent position; 1 random azimuth at the virtual-photon radius; 2 Gaussian transverse displacement with that radius; 3 finite-mass impact-parameter profile with helicity-conserving and helicity-flip terms. This does not set sigma_x/y.

beam_size_scale.meaning: Scale of the finite-beam-size virtual-photon correction.
beam_size_scale.conditions: Dimensionless multiplier used with beam_size; changing it changes the background model.

ext_field.meaning: Apply the inherited strong-field suppression criterion to virtual-photon emission.
ext_field.conditions: 0 off; nonzero criterion. This does not import an external laser or arbitrary external electromagnetic field.

num_lumi.meaning: Capacity of the corresponding electron, electron-photon or photon luminosity event heap.
num_lumi.conditions: Sampling capacity is distinct from total luminosity; optimized append mode uses max(100,num_lumi).

num_lumi_eg.meaning: Capacity of the corresponding electron, electron-photon or photon luminosity event heap.
num_lumi_eg.conditions: Sampling capacity is distinct from total luminosity; optimized append mode uses max(100,num_lumi).

num_lumi_gg.meaning: Capacity of the corresponding electron, electron-photon or photon luminosity event heap.
num_lumi_gg.conditions: Sampling capacity is distinct from total luminosity; optimized append mode uses max(100,num_lumi).

lumi_p.meaning: Area scale converting collision luminosity weight to event-sampling probability for the corresponding heap.
lumi_p.conditions: It controls stored-event sampling, not the total physical luminosity normalization.

lumi_p_eg.meaning: Area scale converting collision luminosity weight to event-sampling probability for the corresponding heap.
lumi_p_eg.conditions: It controls stored-event sampling, not the total physical luminosity normalization.

lumi_p_gg.meaning: Area scale converting collision luminosity weight to event-sampling probability for the corresponding heap.
lumi_p_gg.conditions: It controls stored-event sampling, not the total physical luminosity normalization.

dump_step.meaning: Stride in collision steps or particles for inherited dump output.
dump_step.conditions: Values≤0 are replaced by 1. These controls do not set the deterministic modern GUI frame/sample limits.

dump_particle.meaning: Stride in collision steps or particles for inherited dump output.
dump_particle.conditions: Values≤0 are replaced by 1. These controls do not set the deterministic modern GUI frame/sample limits.

hist_ee_bins.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_ee_bins.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

hist_ee_min.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_ee_min.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

hist_ee_max.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_ee_max.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

hist_espec_bins.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_espec_bins.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

hist_espec_min.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_espec_min.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

hist_espec_max.meaning: Registered inherited histogram setting with no active control of the native spectrum.
hist_espec_max.conditions: Use spectrum_w_min, spectrum_w_max and spectrum_w_bins instead. hist_ee_bins/max are read for diagnostics only; the other legacy histogram keys have no active consumer.

spectrum_w_bins.meaning: Number of uniform native collision-energy bins.
spectrum_w_bins.conditions: Values≤0 fall back to 200. Choose a positive resolved count; display grouping is separate. Inspect underflow/overflow and fit identifiability.

spectrum_w_min.conditions: max>min selects an explicit range; otherwise range is[0,1.1*(E1+E2)]. Tail flows remain separate from retained bins.

spectrum_w_max.conditions: max>min selects an explicit range; otherwise range is[0,1.1*(E1+E2)]. Tail flows remain separate from retained bins.

design_axis_spectrum.meaning: Write a separate output-only spectrum after rotating momenta to declared beam design axes.
design_axis_spectrum.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Retains native collision weights, requires supported serial legacy full-pair output, and is not an independent finite-angle flux calculation.

design_axis_peak_bins.meaning: Fine-bin count between 0.96 and 1.04 times nominal design-axis collision energy.
design_axis_peak_bins.conditions: Integer 100–50000 when enabled. This fine region differs from the 98%diagnostic selection; qualify its bin resolution independently.

rndm_seed.meaning: Seed for a fresh simulation random stream.
rndm_seed.conditions: Used when rndm_load=0. A requested complete checkpoint takes precedence.

rndm_load.meaning: Restore or save the complete checksummed rndm.save state, including Gaussian cache.
rndm_load.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Explicit failed loads stop the run; saves use checked replacement. Defaults are 0, so ordinary repeated cards use their declared seed.

rndm_save.meaning: Restore or save the complete checksummed rndm.save state, including Gaussian cache.
rndm_save.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Explicit failed loads stop the run; saves use checked replacement. Defaults are 0, so ordinary repeated cards use their declared seed.

ip_dispersion.meaning: Canonical horizontal position–energy correlation x+=D*delta, including its longitudinal companion.
ip_dispersion.conditions: Finite signed metres; active independently of crab/waist. Active incoming maps require an explicit longitudinal sign.

crab_mode.conditions: 0 off; 1 ideal linear IP tilt; 2 two-harmonic RF map. Other values rejected. Neither mode is by itself a validated transported RF system.

crab_plane.meaning: Plane of the incoming crab map.
crab_plane.conditions: 0 horizontal; 1 vertical; other values rejected for an active map.

crab_longitudinal_sign.meaning: Sign relating native longitudinal position to the canonical bunch coordinate.
crab_longitudinal_sign.conditions: Exactly +1 or −1 for an active incoming map; default 0 is undeclared and not an automatic beam sign.

crab_target_tilt.conditions: Exactly −1 derives −longitudinal_sign*full_crossing_angle/2; other finite signed values are explicit. Negative slopes other than −1 are not sentinels.

crab_frequency.conditions: Must be positive in RF mode; no RF frequency is needed for a direct linear tilt.

crab_phase.meaning: Common RF phase of the crab harmonics.
crab_phase.conditions: RF mode requires |cos(phase)|≥0.1 to avoid a divergent slope correction.

crab_harmonic_n.meaning: Higher harmonic used with the fundamental to cancel the leading cubic RF term.

crab_include_panofsky_wenzel.meaning: Include the longitudinal kick required by the canonical crab map.
crab_include_panofsky_wenzel.conditions: Must remain enabled for an active crab physics run; 0 is rejected.

crab_full_crossing_angle.meaning: Full crossing angle supplied explicitly to the incoming map configuration.
crab_full_crossing_angle.conditions: Positive angle required when deriving crab tilt or applying an ideal waist; it is not automatically copied from angle_x. Active compensation also checks consistency with the declared beam crossing geometry.

waist_mode.conditions: 0 off; 1 ideal local waist map. Other values rejected; requires nonzero full crossing angle.

waist_fraction.meaning: Fraction multiplying the ideal local waist shift.
waist_fraction.conditions: Finite and≥0; 1 gives the full ideal map. This is not the bunch-tilt compensation fraction.

waist_symplecticity_tolerance.conditions: A checking tolerance, not a predicted collision-observable error.

incoming_map_reslice.meaning: Reassign particles to longitudinal slices after canonical incoming maps.
incoming_map_reslice.conditions: 0 retain existing slices; 1 rebuild. Incompatible with loaded_beam_is_pretransformed=1.

compute_backend.meaning: Select the execution backend for the legacy engine.
compute_backend.conditions: serial, cpu, gpu or auto. Explicit unavailable requests fail unless the particular route allows declared fallback; experimental adaptive routes forbid fallback.

collision_schedule.meaning: Order and concurrency of slice encounters.
collision_schedule.conditions: legacy; wavefront_strict preserves encounter order without a speedup claim; wavefront_parallel stages concurrent fields with ordered publication. Each has process restrictions.

cpu_threads.conditions: Nonnegative integer; 0 chooses detected physical cores where possible. Runtime capacity/useful wave width can reduce the admitted team.

cpu_variant.conditions: auto, pool_dual, pool_private or omp_atomic. OpenMP needs an enabled build; strict/deterministic reduction and physics constraints select the allowed combinations.

cpu_primary_move.meaning: Enable the restricted parallel primary mover.
cpu_primary_move.conditions: 0 off; 1 on. Requires its exact supported feature envelope; wavefront adaptive routes require 0.

gpu_device.meaning: CUDA device ordinal requested by the GPU backend.
gpu_device.conditions: Nonnegative integer; the selected device must exist and satisfy kernel capability requirements.

gpu_min_particles.meaning: Per-slice population threshold for automatic GPU dispatch.
gpu_min_particles.conditions: Nonnegative count; automatic dispatch does not authorize unsupported physics or an unrequested fallback.

gpu_variant.conditions: auto, atomic, shared/tiled or sorted. Individual production modes narrow this grammar; names do not imply every kernel is routed.

gpu_mode.conditions: 1 legacy deposition; 2 resident fields; 3 modern primary-resident; 4 fixed-grid wave batching; 5 adaptive-grid Mode 1 batching. Each requires its full documented selector/physics bundle.

gpu2_scope.meaning: Which resident GPU state is retained.
gpu2_scope.conditions: auto, fields or primary are routed as allowed by the mode; full is refused.

gpu2_deposition.conditions: auto or atomic in supported production paths; shared_tile and sort_reduce are parsed but unrouted and rejected.

gpu2_streams.meaning: Requested CUDA stream count for the resident path.
gpu2_streams.conditions: Nonnegative; 0 is deferred selection. Supported production modes generally require exactly 1; inspect their selector bundle.

gpu2_graphs.conditions: auto, off or on. Production modes constrain the choice; modes 4/5 use off.

gpu2_fusion.conditions: auto, off or on; modes 4/5 require on.

gpu2_batch_slices.conditions: Nonnegative; modes 4/5 require 1–256.0 is not unlimited batching.

gpu2_pinned_io.conditions: auto, off or on; supported modes may require on.

gpu2_host_threads.meaning: Host workers serving the resident GPU path.

gpu2_primary_mover.meaning: Host primary-move implementation used with the resident pipeline.
gpu2_primary_mover.conditions: serial, openmp, pool or auto; supported production bundles narrow these choices.

gpu2_memory_fraction.meaning: Fraction of device memory admitted by resident preflight.
gpu2_memory_fraction.conditions: Finite in(0,1]. This reservation is not a guarantee about total device memory used by other processes.

gpu2_profile.conditions: off, summary or nvtx; the selected mode can require summary.

allow_backend_fallback.meaning: Allow supported automatic fallback from an unavailable acceleration route.
allow_backend_fallback.conditions: 0 fail explicit unavailable requests; 1 permits only documented fallback. Adaptive/certified routes still reject fallback.

reduction_mode.meaning: Floating-point accumulation ordering for the legacy engine.
reduction_mode.conditions: strict, deterministic or fast. Fast atomic accumulation is not bitwise reproducible; each backend admits only its supported combinations.

rng_backend.conditions: legacy is the runnable simulation stream. counter remains a reference/KAT implementation and an unsupported production request fails; checkpoint support alone does not make it a routed physics stream.

sparse_cells.meaning: Restrict cell work to sorted touched-cell unions/intersections while retaining legacy particle insertion order.
sparse_cells.conditions: 0 dense traversal; 1 sparse active-cell bookkeeping. It changes work scheduling, not physical mesh extent.

sparse_direct_interaction_limit.meaning: Maximum direct sparse field-interaction work before the solver chooses its permitted alternative.
sparse_direct_interaction_limit.conditions: Positive integer work bound used with the selected wavefront solver; inspect solver telemetry rather than treating this as a particle cap.

wavefront_field_solver.meaning: Field solver used by wavefront staging.
wavefront_field_solver.conditions: fft, direct or auto are parsed by the wavefront contract; accelerated/adaptive production envelopes require fft.

wavefront_workspace_max_bytes.meaning: Total host wavefront workspace reservation cap in bytes, including any adaptive workspace allowance.
wavefront_workspace_max_bytes.conditions: 0 retains the automatic cap; positive exact integers up to 2^53-1 override it and require wavefront_parallel. Preflight also checks size_t bounds and per-lane capacity before allocation. This is neither an RSS limit nor a device-memory budget.

wavefront_parallel_physics.meaning: Enable the restricted concurrent full primary/photon/luminosity encounter path.
wavefront_parallel_physics.conditions: 0 ordered physics publication; 1 requires the documented precompute/sampling Mode 3 feature bundle. It does not enable arbitrary parallel secondary tracking.

electron_lumi_precompute.meaning: Electron luminosity kernel and invariant-staging selector.
electron_lumi_precompute.conditions: 0 historical; 1 hoisted invariants; 2 blocked aligned SIMD-oriented evaluator; 3 parallel blocked evaluator with separately selected event sampling. Unsupported physics combinations fail.

electron_lumi_sampling.conditions: 0 legacy heap; 1 deterministic weighted top-K; 2 keyed Bernoulli multiplicity; 3 geometric-gap Bernoulli with exact fallback for ineligible rows. Nonzero policies require the matching precompute contract.

photon_lumi_factorized.meaning: Factorize photon-luminosity evaluation in the supported collision kernel.
photon_lumi_factorized.conditions: 0 historical pair loop; 1 factorized route. Coupled exclusions in check_consistency still apply.

electron_lumi_spatial_kernel.meaning: Independent restricted spatial luminosity integration kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_kernel.conditions: 0 off; 1 aggregate-only path. Requires electron_ratio=1, explicit spatial bounds/capacity, no electron event heap or background processes, and grids=1.

electron_lumi_spatial_nx.meaning: Spatial luminosity quadrature dimensions, independent of the field-grid dimensions.
electron_lumi_spatial_nx.conditions: Each≥2 when the spatial kernel is enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_ny.meaning: Spatial luminosity quadrature dimensions, independent of the field-grid dimensions.
electron_lumi_spatial_ny.conditions: Each≥2 when the spatial kernel is enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_x_min.meaning: Explicit spatial support of the luminosity kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_x_min.conditions: Finite bounds with max>min on each axis when enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_x_max.meaning: Explicit spatial support of the luminosity kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_x_max.conditions: Finite bounds with max>min on each axis when enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_y_min.meaning: Explicit spatial support of the luminosity kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_y_min.conditions: Finite bounds with max>min on each axis when enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_y_max.meaning: Explicit spatial support of the luminosity kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_y_max.conditions: Finite bounds with max>min on each axis when enabled.

electron_lumi_spatial_max_pairs.meaning: Hard capacity of the spatial luminosity pair enumeration.
electron_lumi_spatial_max_pairs.conditions: Enabled kernel requires a positive exact integer≤2^53−1 that also fits host size_t; exceeding capacity does not authorize truncation.

electron_lumi_spatial_closure_tolerance.meaning: Relative closure tolerance for the spatial luminosity kernel.
electron_lumi_spatial_closure_tolerance.conditions: Finite in(0,1) when enabled; this algebraic closure is not collider numerical accuracy.

engine.meaning: Physics-engine family, independent of the legacy compute_backend selector.
engine.conditions: legacy is default; modern_ref_cpu and modern_cpu are reserved/unavailable; modern_gpu admits only the narrow gpu_mode3 contract.

algorithm.meaning: Algorithm declaration for a modern engine.
algorithm.conditions: exact, factored_exact, sampled_validated or adaptive_validated are declared names; current production modern_gpu requires exact. Nondefault values require a nonlegacy engine and separate support.

precision.conditions: fp64 or mixed_qualified; the narrow modern_gpu route uses FP32 phase state with FP64 fields. A selector name is not broad numerical qualification.

modern_reduction.conditions: deterministic or fast_qualified; the narrow GPU route requires fast_qualified unordered FP64 atomic CIC.

modern_batch_width.conditions: Nonnegative; 0 is the reserved engine-selected sentinel. Current production bundle requires 0.

modern_cpu_workers.meaning: Requested workers for a modern CPU engine.
modern_cpu_workers.conditions: Nonnegative; 0 is reserved engine selection. Modern CPU engines are unavailable; current GPU bundle retains 0.

modern_cpu_runtime.conditions: auto, pool or openmp grammar; current production GPU bundle retains auto and does not activate a modern CPU engine.

modern_cpu_affinity.conditions: auto, none, compact or scatter grammar; current production GPU bundle retains auto.

modern_gpu_streams.conditions: Nonnegative; current primary-resident production bundle uses 1.

modern_gpu_graphs.conditions: auto, off or on grammar; current primary-resident production bundle requires off.

modern_trace.conditions: off, summary or full grammar; supported production bundle uses summary.

adaptive_grid_error_reference_field.meaning: Prospectively fixed E_ref used by the mixed absolute/relative field-error metric.
adaptive_grid_error_reference_field.conditions: Finite>0 for vector_mixed_rms_quantile_v2; exactly 0 under other policies. Bind its external budget by error_budget_sha256.

adaptive_grid_error_absolute_floor_fract.meaning: Fraction of E_ref setting the mixed metric denominator floor.
adaptive_grid_error_absolute_floor_fract.conditions: Finite in(0,1] for V2; exactly 0 under other policies.

adaptive_grid_error_catastrophe_absolute.meaning: Fraction of E_ref required in addition to the relative catastrophe bound.
adaptive_grid_error_catastrophe_absolute.conditions: Finite in(0,2] for V2; exactly 0 under other policies.

adaptive_grid_error_exposure_limit.meaning: Maximum accepted-target fraction exceeding the declared V2 field-error target.
adaptive_grid_error_exposure_limit.conditions: Finite in(0,1) for V2; exactly 0 under other policies.

adaptive_macroparticle_mode.meaning: `0..3`; see Section 2. Any other value fails during card parsing.
adaptive_macroparticle_mode.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_domain.meaning: The enum is `field_source` or `full_physics`; an active `full_physics` request fails because variable-weight physics is not qualified.
adaptive_macroparticle_domain.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_source_evolution.meaning: The enum also reserves `persistent_replayed_roots`, which fails for an active mode. A standalone ordinary-MC replay planner/executor exists under `scripts/adaptive_particles/replay/`, but FeeBL does not consume its policy as persistent adaptive state and the required evolution contract is not implemented.
adaptive_macroparticle_source_evolution.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_decision_scope.meaning: Exactly `encounter`. Decisions are prepared from an immutable encounter view.
adaptive_macroparticle_decision_scope.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_commit_scope.meaning: Exactly `wave`. Activation cannot occur during an in-flight parallel encounter.
adaptive_macroparticle_commit_scope.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_strategy.meaning: Exactly this versioned identifier. A deterministic conservative-sum controller observes frozen diagnostics only after the canonical wave publication barrier. It keeps mesh, source, resampling, pair, stochastic-physics, solver, floating-point, and reference errors distinct; unavailable source-sampling uncertainty cannot be cleared by descendants. A fresh-root recommendation becomes a process-level signal only; the standalone replay driver is not invoked and no live roots are inserted.
adaptive_macroparticle_strategy.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_split.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_merge.meaning: Required as versioned provenance in every active mode; Mode 3 executes it, while Modes 1/2 retain the identifier without merging. This is not the future general `mpcr_v1` algorithm.
adaptive_macroparticle_merge.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_root_source.meaning: Exactly this identifier in the current implementation. Roots are the already-generated authoritative FeeBL primaries. `pilot_replay_rqmc_v1` and every other generator request fail closed because no replay/RQMC root generator is active.
adaptive_macroparticle_root_source.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_root_seed.meaning: Must remain zero with `physical_primary_roots_v1`; the adaptive-source path draws no root RNG values. The standalone ordinary-MC replay driver changes the legacy `rndm_seed` in fresh cards, not this field. A future in-process/RQMC namespace requires a separate generator and schema.
adaptive_macroparticle_root_seed.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_scramble_id.meaning: Must remain zero. The current run has no adaptive RQMC scramble, and descendants are not independent replications.
adaptive_macroparticle_scramble_id.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_error_target.meaning: Modes 2/3 require a value strictly between zero and one; supplied active cards use `0.01`. It is a declared coupled-controller target, but the exact-projection transaction does not yet turn it into a collider observable error certificate.
adaptive_macroparticle_error_target.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_resample_bias_tar.meaning: Modes 2/3 require a value below one. For exact projection it is the explicit relative-L1 budget for differences between independently accumulated legacy-oracle and weighted-source density/S1/S2 arrays. Active smoke cards use `1e-8`; the observed residual remains logged. This is not a general resampling algorithm or physics-error budget.
adaptive_macroparticle_resample_bias_tar.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_min_root_support.meaning: Controller threshold for distinct-root and protected-tail support. Never compared to representative count.
adaptive_macroparticle_min_root_support.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_min_clone_support.meaning: Controller threshold for the conservative root-grouped clone-support proxy, which splitting cannot inflate.
adaptive_macroparticle_min_clone_support.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_statistical_cohor.meaning: Must be exactly `1` for `projected_current_state` in this implementation. Zero is always invalid.
adaptive_macroparticle_statistical_cohor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_refine_threshold.meaning: Must be at least the coarsen threshold. Applied to normalized mesh and independently estimated source errors.
adaptive_macroparticle_refine_threshold.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_coarsen_threshold.meaning: Must not exceed the refine threshold. Both errors and resampling risk must remain below it before dwell can permit a Mode-3 merge recommendation.
adaptive_macroparticle_coarsen_threshold.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_update_interval.meaning: Must be nonzero and, in this implementation, exactly `1`.
adaptive_macroparticle_update_interval.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_cooldown.meaning: Must be exactly `0` until persistent controller state is implemented.
adaptive_macroparticle_cooldown.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_dwell.meaning: Must be nonzero and, in this implementation, exactly `2`.
adaptive_macroparticle_dwell.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_max_change_factor.meaning: Must be at least one. A committed proposal cannot contain more than `ceil(factor * accepted_roots)` representatives. Four is the natural maximum for exact 2D CIC splitting.
adaptive_macroparticle_max_change_factor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_max_generation.meaning: Must be nonzero and fit `uint32_t`; every split/merge generation is checked. The current projection uses generation 1 for splits and 2 after Mode-3 merge.
adaptive_macroparticle_max_generation.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_max_count.meaning: Zero means no user-imposed small count ceiling. A positive value rejects a proposal above it; real host/address-space limits still apply.
adaptive_macroparticle_max_count.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_max_bytes.meaning: Zero selects automatic resource preflight. A positive value is a source-container admission guard, not a process RSS or GPU-memory promise.
adaptive_macroparticle_max_bytes.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_max_weight_ratio.meaning: Must be at least one. For exact CIC field-source projection it bounds the accepted authoritative **root** weight ratio, not the ratio of arbitrarily small nonzero CIC atom coefficients. The representative atom range remains telemetry.
adaptive_macroparticle_max_weight_ratio.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_policy_save.meaning: Any nonempty value fails closed. The in-process card/runtime policy schema is not implemented; the standalone replay driver's canonical JSON policy is a separate artifact and is not accepted here.
adaptive_macroparticle_policy_save.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_policy_load.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_trace_save.meaning: Any nonempty value fails closed. The in-process realization-specific trace schema is not implemented; the standalone replay execution manifest is separate.
adaptive_macroparticle_trace_save.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_trace_load.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_profile.meaning: `off`, `summary`, or `detail`. This selects particle-source telemetry verbosity, not scientific qualification.
adaptive_macroparticle_profile.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_fail_on_unmet_err.meaning: Exactly `0` or `1`. Transaction failures remain hard errors. For Mode 2/3, `1` emits the versioned replay signal and returns status 75 before final output publication when the end-to-end bound is unavailable/unmet. Value `0` emits the same signal with an exploratory exit-0 disposition and then permits unqualified pilot outputs; it does not relabel the run as converged.
adaptive_macroparticle_fail_on_unmet_err.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_macroparticle_determinism.meaning: The grammar recognizes `strict` or `fast_qualified`, but every active mode in this implementation requires `strict`. `fast_qualified` is reserved until a separate numerical qualification exists.
adaptive_macroparticle_determinism.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_mode.meaning: Grid topology:0 fixed,1 exact-discretization active window,2 error-controlled uniform refinement,3 experimental composite patch. `0`, `1`, `2`, or `3`; this contract covers `2` and `3`.
adaptive_grid_mode.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_scope.meaning: Scope at which an adaptive field decision is made. The parser recognizes `"encounter"` and diagnostic `"wave"`, but executable Modes 2/3 require `"encounter"`; `"wave"` is refused rather than substituted.
adaptive_grid_scope.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_size_classes_x.meaning: Paired, strictly increasing lists of positive even window dimensions. Required if full-window selection is disabled.
adaptive_grid_size_classes_x.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_size_classes_y.meaning: Paired, strictly increasing lists of positive even window dimensions. Required if full-window selection is disabled.
adaptive_grid_size_classes_y.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_min_nx.meaning: Zero means derive an executable minimum of four later; otherwise an even dimension at least four.
adaptive_grid_min_nx.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_min_ny.meaning: Zero means derive an executable minimum of four later; otherwise an even dimension at least four.
adaptive_grid_min_ny.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_nx.meaning: Zero means derive later; otherwise even, at least four, and no smaller than the matching minimum.
adaptive_grid_max_nx.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_ny.meaning: Zero means derive later; otherwise even, at least four, and no smaller than the matching minimum.
adaptive_grid_max_ny.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_extra_guard_cells.meaning: Nonnegative extra cells around exact stencil support. An explicit maximum must leave at least a two-cell physical interior.
adaptive_grid_extra_guard_cells.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_allow_full_window.meaning: Boolean. A full canonical window is a selected class, not fallback.
adaptive_grid_allow_full_window.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_cells.meaning: Exact nonnegative integer represented in binary64. Required positive capacity in Modes 2/3 and must contain explicit minima.
adaptive_grid_max_cells.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_bytes.meaning: Exact nonnegative integer represented in binary64. Required positive total adaptive CPU reservation in Modes 2/3. Preflight divides it across admitted lanes, reserves transient controller high-water, and uses only the remainder for retained contexts. It is not an RSS limit.
adaptive_grid_max_bytes.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_schedule_save.meaning: Path for writing an adaptive schedule. Both must remain empty in executable Modes 2/3 until schedule format v2 exists.
adaptive_grid_schedule_save.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_schedule_load.meaning: Path for loading a prescribed adaptive schedule. Both must remain empty in executable Modes 2/3 until schedule format v2 exists.
adaptive_grid_schedule_load.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_profile.meaning: Adaptive-grid telemetry verbosity. `off`, `summary`, or `encounter`; Modes 2/3 require `summary` or `encounter`.
adaptive_grid_profile.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_pilot_diagnostics.meaning: Explicitly authorizes an **unqualified diagnostic pilot** only when set to `1` together with `adaptive_grid_fail_on_unmet_error=0` and `adaptive_grid_profile="encounter"`. It is rejected in Modes 0/1 and when the other two settings do not match.
adaptive_grid_pilot_diagnostics.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_model.meaning: Field-source representation: reference_cic_v1 uses a registered CIC source lattice; fixed_width_bspline1_v1 uses continuous tents of fixed physical width. Required exact versioned name in Modes 2/3.
adaptive_grid_source_model.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_reference_nx.meaning: Reference-source lattice cells in x, held fixed when refining the field grid. Positive for `reference_cic_v1`; exactly zero for the fixed-width model.
adaptive_grid_source_reference_nx.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_reference_ny.meaning: Reference-source lattice cells in y, held fixed when refining the field grid. Positive for `reference_cic_v1`; exactly zero for the fixed-width model.
adaptive_grid_source_reference_ny.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_width_x.meaning: Physical tent support half-widths in nm.  Finite and positive for `fixed_width_bspline1_v1`; exactly zero for `reference_cic_v1`.  Never scale them with grid factor.
adaptive_grid_source_width_x.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_width_y.meaning: Physical tent support half-widths in nm.  Finite and positive for `fixed_width_bspline1_v1`; exactly zero for `reference_cic_v1`.  Never scale them with grid factor.
adaptive_grid_source_width_y.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_source_error_target.meaning: Relative source-representation error budget. Required finite value in `(0,1)` for either audited source; bounds uniform source-luminosity error against its source oracle.
adaptive_grid_source_error_target.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_solver_error_target.meaning: Relative field solve/gather error budget. Required finite value in `(0,1)` for either audited source; bounds the uniform field-solve/gather estimate together with the overall/Richardson targets.
adaptive_grid_solver_error_target.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_lumi_error_target.meaning: Relative luminosity error budget for composite versus uniform-fine overlap. Required finite value in `(0,1)` for either audited source; bounds Mode-3 hybrid luminosity against complete uniform-fine luminosity.
adaptive_grid_lumi_error_target.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_lumi_floor.meaning: Required finite positive normalization floor for audited luminosity comparisons.
adaptive_grid_lumi_floor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_field_spacing_classes.meaning: Bootstrap physical refinement factors; not a list of allowed final window dimensions. Required bootstrap list of at least three consecutive ratio-two classes beginning at factor 1.
adaptive_grid_field_spacing_classes.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_refinement_factor.meaning: `0` removes a user-imposed factor ceiling; otherwise a power of two no smaller than the last bootstrap class. Resource and representability limits always remain active.
adaptive_grid_max_refinement_factor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_field_operator.meaning: `legacy_cic12_v1` or `fd4_lagrange4_v1`. The latter is the qualification candidate and affects only CPU Modes 2/3.
adaptive_grid_field_operator.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_anchor_x.meaning: Physical x anchor of the adaptive lattice. Must be finite at parse time; executable v1 currently requires both exactly zero and fails closed otherwise.
adaptive_grid_anchor_x.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_anchor_y.meaning: Physical y anchor of the adaptive lattice. Must be finite at parse time; executable v1 currently requires both exactly zero and fails closed otherwise.
adaptive_grid_anchor_y.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_monitor.meaning: Indicator construction, currently charge_curvature_field_richardson_overlap. Exact v1 monitor identifier.
adaptive_grid_monitor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_target.meaning: Requested overall normalized field-error target. Required finite value in `(0,1)`.
adaptive_grid_error_target.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_norm_policy.meaning: The default preserves the established componentwise RMS-and-maximum acceptance exactly. The opt-in `vector_rms_quantile_v1` policy uses the no-floor same-particle vector audit below; `vector_mixed_rms_quantile_v2` uses the separately documented mixed absolute/relative audit. Both vector policies require measured `three_level` order.
adaptive_grid_error_norm_policy.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_budget_sha256.meaning: Mandatory only for `vector_mixed_rms_quantile_v2`: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters identifying the immutable prospectively approved kick/error-budget document. It must be empty for every other policy. It is part of the adaptive schedule/run identity and receipts; campaign validation must authenticate the referenced document bytes.
adaptive_grid_error_budget_sha256.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_quantile.meaning: Empirical upper quantile used by `vector_rms_quantile_v1`; must be finite in `[0.95,1)`. The default is p99.9.
adaptive_grid_error_quantile.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_catastrophe_limit.meaning: Hard per-particle symmetric-vector change bound for `vector_rms_quantile_v1`; finite in `(0,2]`, where two is the exact mathematical maximum. This guard is separate from the quantile so a small hidden tail cannot pass.
adaptive_grid_error_catastrophe_limit.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_noise_aware_stop.meaning: Optional pilot-only fail-closed early stop. Value `1` requires `vector_rms_quantile_v1`, `pilot_diagnostics=1`, `fail_on_unmet_error=0`, and replay-capable adaptive macroparticle mode 2 or 3. It never creates a convergence result.
adaptive_grid_noise_aware_stop.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_tau_curvature.meaning: Normalized charge-curvature indicator tolerance. Required finite normalized tolerance in `(0,1)`.
adaptive_grid_tau_curvature.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_tau_field_gradient.meaning: Normalized field-gradient indicator tolerance. Required finite normalized tolerance in `(0,1)`.
adaptive_grid_tau_field_gradient.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_tau_richardson.meaning: Normalized same-particle Richardson field-difference tolerance. Required finite normalized tolerance in `(0,1)`.
adaptive_grid_tau_richardson.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_encounter_tail_fraction.meaning: Finite eligibility-mass control in `[0,1)`. Zero is a compatibility sentinel that inherits `adaptive_grid_tau_tail`; a positive value explicitly bounds the whole slice-pair population fraction eligible for the longitudinal treatment below.
adaptive_grid_encounter_tail_fraction.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_tau_tail.meaning: Required finite normalized tolerance in `(0,1)`. It independently bounds (a) each cumulative exposure-weighted longitudinal error and (b) Mode-3 patch-excluded source charge. It no longer controls eligible longitudinal mass when `adaptive_grid_encounter_tail_fraction` is positive.
adaptive_grid_tau_tail.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_rho_floor.meaning: Charge-density normalization floor for controller indicators. Required finite positive, calibrated noise/scale floors.
adaptive_grid_rho_floor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_field_floor.meaning: Field normalization floor for controller indicators. Required finite positive, calibrated noise/scale floors.
adaptive_grid_field_floor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_indicator_smoothing_passes.meaning: `0`, `1`, or `2`; applies to indicators, never the physics source.
adaptive_grid_indicator_smoothing_passes.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_indicator_reduction.meaning: Spatial indicator grouping, currently connected_max. Exact v1 reduction identifier.
adaptive_grid_indicator_reduction.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_refine_threshold.meaning: Normalized indicator threshold for requesting refinement. Finite and positive.
adaptive_grid_refine_threshold.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_coarsen_threshold.meaning: Finite overlap fraction in `[0,1]`, and strictly below the refine threshold. Mode 3 uses it directly as its connected-overlap patch threshold.
adaptive_grid_coarsen_threshold.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_shrink_dwell.meaning: Reserved number of accepted updates before shrinking a grid. Must be explicitly set to `1`; stateful hysteresis is not implemented.
adaptive_grid_shrink_dwell.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_update_interval.meaning: Encounter interval between controller updates. Must equal `1`; deferred encounter updates are not implemented.
adaptive_grid_update_interval.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_richardson_interval.meaning: Encounter interval between same-particle Richardson audits. Must be explicitly set to `1`; skipped Richardson audits are not implemented.
adaptive_grid_richardson_interval.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_richardson_order_source.meaning: Choose tabulated or measured three-level convergence order. `calibrated_table` or `three_level`.
adaptive_grid_richardson_order_source.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_richardson_order_table.meaning: For `calibrated_table`, required pair entries for every pair that execution may reach, including dynamically appended factors, for example `"1:2=2.0,2:4=2.0,4:8=2.0"`; alternatively use a nonzero maximum factor to bound the calibrated table. Must be empty for `three_level`.
adaptive_grid_richardson_order_table.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_min_neff.meaning: Minimum weighted Kish effective occupancy required by sampling gates. Required finite value at least one.
adaptive_grid_min_neff.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_fail_on_unmet_error.meaning: Production-safe default. A value of `0` is accepted only for the explicitly gated unqualified diagnostic pilot described below.
adaptive_grid_fail_on_unmet_error.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_levels.meaning: Maximum nested fine-patch depth. Exactly one nested fine level in v1.
adaptive_grid_max_levels.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_max_patches.meaning: Maximum simultaneously admitted fine rectangles. Exactly one fine rectangle in v1.
adaptive_grid_max_patches.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_refinement_ratio.meaning: Fine/coarse spatial resolution ratio of a patch. Exactly `2` in executable contract v1.
adaptive_grid_refinement_ratio.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_blocking_factor.meaning: Cell-alignment block size for patch geometry. Required positive power of two, divisible by the refinement ratio; every explicit window class must be divisible by it.
adaptive_grid_blocking_factor.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_error_buffer_cells.meaning: Cells added around the indicator-selected patch support. Required positive calibrated buffer.
adaptive_grid_error_buffer_cells.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_transition_cells.meaning: Width of the C1 potential blend at patch boundaries. Required positive and even in v1.
adaptive_grid_transition_cells.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_fine_residual_tolerance.meaning: Normalized harmonic fine-patch residual acceptance threshold. Required finite value in `(0,1)`.
adaptive_grid_fine_residual_tolerance.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.

adaptive_grid_terminal_patch_certificati.meaning: Experimental, default-off terminal recovery proof. Value `1` requires Mode 3, `fixed_width_bspline1_v1`, `fd4_lagrange4_v1`, `vector_rms_quantile_v1`, rolling `three_level` order, adaptive macroparticles off, and encounter telemetry. It never weakens any ordinary Mode-3 path.
adaptive_grid_terminal_patch_certificati.conditions: Active-mode and coupled constraints in the native input checks also apply.
